_comment: The scanner's rule-class state. It is installed into the private HOME the Aegis gate scans under, so the developer's own Aegis configuration can never switch a rule off and silently change what CI sees. The list below is empty on purpose: decision 0074 keeps every rule class armed and adjudicates each occurrence individually in .aegis-baseline.tsv, and decision 0070's class-level evidence survives as the reason written next to each class's rows. Adding a class here would suppress it for the whole tree, including findings a later change introduces.
